method: 72 synchronized renders on frozen ce66dcb,960x640 SwiftShader. Current shader vs same shader with emissive contribution removed (compiler can remove unused schedule); current water vs exact M15 water module in same final scene; avatar shown/hidden. Three profiles,4 samples per state after4 warm renders. Shader ablations keep seed/flow allocations resident, so allocation savings are not inferred. Sequential small samples, no hardware claim; noise and unfavorable values retained.
